title: THE JIGGLE FOLLOWS THE BODY
why: Measured walking in a raid after v20.02: the chest sat on its limit at every step, which reads as a glitch. Two causes: the spring rang at the same pace as the footsteps, so each step pumped it higher, and it was fed the walk across the map as well as the body bob. It is now a quicker spring, clear of the walking and sprinting pace, damped so each wobble is gone before the next step, fed only the body rise and fall, and stepped in small slices so a slow frame cannot throw it.
now: The Curved jiggle bounces with each step and settles, instead of shaking.
